name: Frame Window Recorder
description: Measures click frame windows with local survival tests, colored in-level rings and sound cues.

max-shift.name: Max probe shift
max-shift.description: Maximum number of physics frames to test early and late for each input.

analyze-releases.name: Analyze releases
analyze-releases.description: Also measure release timing windows. Disable to measure presses only.

inject-offset.name: Replay inject offset
inject-offset.description: If a clean macro replay is consistently one tick off, try -1 or +1.

validation-frames.name: Validation horizon
validation-frames.description: How many physics ticks a shifted click must survive before it counts as valid. Shorter avoids unrelated later deaths.

next-input-slack.name: Next input slack
next-input-slack.description: Stops a probe this many ticks before the next independent click, so a later click is not blamed on the one being measured.
